newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish PBR rates KPBP Bick a hold.
newsitem.headline: Polish PBR rates KPBP Bick a hold.

text.p: The brokerage unit of Polish Development Bank (PBR) initiated the coverage of the Polish construction company KPBP Bich with a hold recommendation.
PBR said in a report dated August 20, but released on Monday, that the company's stock after a 61 percent surge this year, was fairly valued but still had some room for growth.

The report said KPBP Bick was set to benefit from the recovery of the whole construction industry as it was expanding into most promising sectors such as environmental investments and avoided currently unprofitable residential building. @
PBR said it saw KPBP Bick net profit rising to 2.4 million zlotys this year and to 2.9 million zlotys next year, from 1.6 million in 1995.
It saw KPBP Bick's sales growing to 79 million zlotys in 1996 and 93.3 million in 1997, up from last year's 58.3 million zlotys.
KPBP Bick closed at 16.9 zlotys on Monday.
